records.title: Le Refuge (The Refuge)
records.meta: Film · France · French · dir. François Ozon
records.summary: Mousse, pregnant by her late partner Louis, retreats to a seaside house where his brother Paul joins her; a tender, intimate bond develops and one review says they make love. Isabelle Carré was really pregnant during filming. Already has children: no. Pregnant at the end: no — she has given birth to a daughter.

records.kids_together: no (the father Louis dies early; Paul is not the father)
